scientific.integrity: The defining Mime control-variate update is specialized directly to deterministic quadratic clients with SGD as the base optimizer. The one-, two-, and three-step average formulas are derived exactly without asymptotic truncation.
limitations: One deterministic communication round with a fixed equally weighted client set.
Quadratic client objectives with symmetric Hessians.
SGD as the base optimizer and exact local gradients.
No claim for stochastic mini-batches, client sampling, adaptive base optimizers, or more than three local steps.
The third-step correction is gradient-aligned in inner product, not guaranteed to improve the final objective.

title: Mime's first quadratic averaging defect appears at the third local step
